chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi honors his promise to spend time with Gu Suizhou, leading to a surfing lesson. C2, an observer, interacts with Leapton while Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou navigate their dynamic. Gu Suizhou attempts to act cool by skipping beginner surfing steps, resulting in him being humbled by the waves. The chapter highlights the contrast between Shen Feizhi's competence and Gu Suizhou's performative, attention-seeking behavior.
